brief.caption: Some companies hold Bitcoin on their balance sheet. Some countries hold it in reserve. Different playbooks, same long term view.
brief.caption_de: Manche Unternehmen halten Bitcoin in der Bilanz. Manche Staaten halten es in ihren Reserven. Unterschiedliche Wege, derselbe langfristige Blick.

brief.purpose: Show that Bitcoin adoption spans both corporate and national balance sheets, reinforcing long term legitimacy.
brief.target_feeling: Quiet confidence, credibility by association, forward looking calm.

Some companies put Bitcoin on their balance sheet.
Some countries put it in their reserves.
Both made a long term bet.

brief.caption: You work for decades and save every month. Then the money supply grows and that money buys less. Bitcoin gets called the risky one.
brief.caption_de: Du arbeitest jahrzehntelang, sparst jeden Monat. Dann wird einfach mehr Geld gedruckt und es kauft weniger. Und Bitcoin gilt als das Risiko.
brief.headline: Who's the risky one?
brief.purpose: Challenge the assumption that fiat is the safe choice by pointing at inflation, without predicting Bitcoin's price.
brief.target_feeling: Mild provocation, a reframe that makes the reader pause.
brief.visual_direction: Simple line chart with one orange line drifting slowly downward across a plain axis, no numbers or labels on the axis, no illustration. Just the line and lots of white space. Logo bottom right.

suggestions.rationale: strong likes and one of the higher repost counts in the batch, the inflation contrast clearly lands with this audience
suggestions.text:
Work for decades. Save every month.
Then the money supply gets printed and that money buys less.
And people call Bitcoin the risky one?

brief.caption_de: Bitcoin steht hinter keiner Regierung und keiner Bank. Es steht hinter den Menschen, die es halten.
brief.headline: Backed by everyone who holds it.
brief.headline_de: Gehalten von allen, die daran glauben.

brief.target_feeling: Calm certainty, a settled feeling of understanding something obvious.
brief.visual_direction: Type treatment only: the word 'everyone' set large in Relai orange, the rest of the sentence in black around it at smaller size. No network graphics, no dots. Generous white space. Logo bottom right.

suggestions.rationale: one of the older but consistently well liked posts, the belief framing keeps getting repeated across the archive
suggestions.text:
Bitcoin isn't backed by a government or a bank.
It's backed by everyone who chooses to hold it.

suggestions.text:

100 million of them make a Bitcoin.

suggestions.text:
Cash sitting still doesn't stay the same size.

brief.caption: Bitcoin doesn't ask what you paid for it. It only asks how long you're willing to hold it.

suggestions.text:
Bitcoin doesn't ask what you paid for it.
It only asks how long you're willing to hold it.
